options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

options.doc_fr:
Un système qui peut déplacer la progression plus tôt, pour essayer et empêcher le joueur de se coincer et s'ennuyer tôt.

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_html:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

Full: ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

Minimal: ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_fr:
Définir les règles d'accessibilité de vos objets/emplacements.

**Full:** s'assurer que tout peut être atteint et acquis.

**Minimal:** s'assurer que ce qui est nécessaire pour atteindre votre objectif peut être acquis.

options.name: goal
options.doc:
What action is required to completed to goal?
Certificate: Open the chest that gives you the certificate.
Tower: Climb the Magical Tower, and defeat Devil.
Souvenirs: Get the 7 souvenirs and give them to your mother.
gems: Get the 7 gems and open the secret door in the library.

options.name: Required Secret Stones
options.doc:
How many secret stones are required to get the final exam certificate.  If zero, the ability to ascend Sage's Mountain
is all that is needed to get it.  Note that the Magical Tower requires nothing save combat experience to clear.
options.doc_fr: Combien de pierres secrètes sont nécessaires pour obtenir le certificat d'examen final. Si zéro, la capacité de monter la montagne de Sage est tout ce qui est nécessaire pour l'obtenir. Notez que la tour magique n'exige rien d'autre que l'expérience de combat à effacer.

options.name: School Lunch
options.doc:
Whether the starting 'school lunch' you have (the four Pickled Scallions) are randomized.
Vanilla: Don't touch the items.
Consumables: They are four random consumables or equipment items instead.
Anything: They can be any item.

options.name: Starting Magic
options.doc:
What magic Arle should start with, out of the starting spells.
If this list is not default the other spells will be locations that send on start.

options.name: Souvenir Hunt
options.doc: The shop souvenirs are shuffled, try to find them!

options.name: Starting Cookies
options.doc: How many cookies you start with.
options.doc_fr: Combien de cookies vous commencez par.

options.name: Reduced Encounters
options.doc:
Halves the rate of encounters.  Helps as some places are labyrinthine and will cause a lot of encounters to happen.
Also can offset the 4x encounter rate from holding Scorpion's Wallet
options.doc_fr:
Le rythme des rencontres. Aide comme certains endroits sont labyrinthine et provoquera beaucoup de rencontres à se produire.
Peut également compenser le taux de rencontre 4x en tenant le portefeuille de Scorpion

options.name: Squirrel Stations
options.doc: Randomizes the ability to use the squirrel station to go to certain locations.  Reaching destinations is a location.

options.name: Bestiary
options.doc: Whether meeting an encounter for the first time is a location.

options.name: Skip Fairy Search
options.doc:
Skips the event where the fairy at the top of Sage Mountain goes missing, so when you have the necessary secrest stones you
can immediately get the certificate.  If Bestiary is on, this removes the Owlbear location as it is not encountered.
